description: Count the disposition records belonging to accounts that have no 'DISPONENT' disposition at all.

b.request: Count the disposition rows whose associated account has no disposition of type `DISPONENT`.
b.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disp AS d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM disp AS d2 WHERE d2.account_id = d.account_id AND d2.type = 'DISPONENT');
b.raw: Count the disposition rows whose associated account has no disposition of type `DISPONENT`.

c.request: How many disposition records belong to non-disponent accounts? Count each disposition row, not each account. Count the disposition records belonging to accounts that have no 'DISPONENT' disposition at all.
c.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS disposition_count
FROM disp AS d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM disp AS disponent
    WHERE disponent.account_id = d.account_id
      AND disponent.type = 'DISPONENT'
);

d.request: Count each disposition row whose associated account has no disposition of type 'DISPONENT'.
d.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disp AS d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM disp AS d2 WHERE d2.account_id = d.account_id AND d2.type = 'DISPONENT');

a.request: How many disposition records (each `disp` row, not distinct accounts) belong to accounts that have no disposition at all with `type` 'DISPONENT'?
a.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM disp AS d WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM disp AS d2 WHERE d2.account_id = d.account_id AND d2.type = 'DISPONENT');
